faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya recruitment is 21st September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are being advertised by Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya?
faq.answer: Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya is recruiting for the posts of Finance Officer, Professors, Associate Professors, and Assistant Professors. These positions are for full-time employment within the university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or the provided application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General/OBC category candidates?
faq.answer: For General and OBC category candidates, the application fee is Rs. 2500/-. This fee is payable online as part of the application submission process.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any relaxation in the application fee for SC/ST and Women candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, there is a reduced application fee for SC/ST and Women candidates. They are required to pay Rs. 1000/- as their application fee.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is highly recommended to download and read the PDF carefully before applying.

faq.question: Q7. What is the official website of Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya?
faq.answer: The official website of Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya is www.ggu.ac.in. You can find more information about the university and its activities there.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya recruitment is 6995/Rec/Admn/2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: All the advertised positions are for Full Time employment at Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya.

faq.question: Q10. In which state and city is Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya located?
faq.answer: Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya is located in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh. The recruitment is for candidates applying to positions within this university.
